verdict.rationale: Docs confirm ops can configure 'verification levels' (sequences of steps) and AML screening settings directly, implying dashboard-based configuration without code (sumsub-docs-5, sumsub-docs-25, sumsub-docs-6). However, there is no explicit evidence of conditional step logic, risk-based routing rules, or country-specific requirement branching being configurable without an engineering deploy — only general coverage of document types across countries (sumsub-docs-11) and branding/step customization (sumsub-docs-7, sumsub-docs-18), not logic branching. missing for 10: explicit no-code conditional/branching logic UI, risk-based routing configuration, country-specific rule setup, and confirmation that changes deploy without engineering involvement.
